You'll identify target accounts, engage decision-makers through multi-channel outreach, qualify opportunities, and book meetings with companies that have meaningful revenue potential.</p> <p>You'll have the autonomy and freedom to test messaging, refine outbound strategies, and help shape how OtterlyAI goes to market. We care about quality over quantity—you'll focus on opening doors where OtterlyAI can create meaningful business impact, not simply hitting activity metrics.</p> <h3><strong>Main Responsibilities:</strong></h3> <p><strong>1. Outbound Pipeline Generation:</strong> Build and manage outbound campaigns targeting marketing leaders, SEO teams, digital agencies, and enterprise organizations using LinkedIn, email, phone, and other creative outreach channels.<br><strong>2. Account-Based Prospecting</strong>: Research and prioritize high-value accounts, identify key stakeholders, and develop personalized outreach that cuts through the noise.<br><strong>3. Multi-Channel Outreach:</strong> Execute thoughtful cold and warm outreach across LinkedIn,<br>email, calling, and other channels to consistently generate qualified meetings.<br><strong>4. Opportunity Qualification:</strong> Understand prospect pain points, qualify opportunities, and ensure every meeting handed to an Account Executive has a strong likelihood of progressing.<br><strong>5. Pipeline Development: </strong>Own your pipeline targets by generating qualified opportunities that contribute directly to company growth and revenue.<br><strong>6. Market Intelligence: </strong>Continuously gather insights from prospects, competitors, and the AI search landscape to improve messaging and identify new opportunities.<br><strong>7. Process Improvement: </strong>Help optimize outbound playbooks, messaging, sequencing, and targeting as we continue to scale our sales motion.<br><br></p> <h3>Main requirements:&nbsp;</h3> <p><strong>Must Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>4+ years of outbound BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS ( MarTech, SEO, AI or Digital Marketing Solutions)</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record of consistently exceeding outbound meeting or pipeline targets</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience prospecting into mid-market and enterprise organizations</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong LinkedIn, email, and cold-calling skills</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience using tools: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, or similar outbound tools</p> </li> <li> <p>Fluent English (C1+)</p> </li> <li> <p>Self-starter who enjoys ownership in a fast-growing remote scale-up</p> </li> <li> <p>Available to collaborate across EU and US time zones.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Familiarity with Account-Based Sales (ABS) or Account-Based Marketing (ABM)</p> </li> <li> <p>Additional European languages</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building outbound campaigns from scratch.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><br>What OtterlyAI Offers:</h3> <ul> <li> <p>€4,000/month base (B2B contractor arrangement)</p> </li> <li> <p>Uncapped commission based on qualified pipeline and closed business</p> </li> <li> <p>Remote-first - work from anywhere in Europe</p> </li> <li> <p>Flexible schedule with overlap across Europe and US timezones</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct collaboration with founders and sales leadership</p> </li> <li> <p>Opportunity to help define and scale OtterlyAI's outbound motion</p> </li> </ul> <h3><br>Recruitment Process:</h3> <p><strong>1.CV and brief selection:</strong>&nbsp;<br>When submitting your CV, please also include a short note <br>of 3 -
